visual_review: Five actual retained images reviewed: desktop surface-band, below-0.4-knot and September-25 maximum cards; mobile below-bound and September-25 cards. Exactly one Nelson diagnostic heading per source card after correction. The strict bound applies to most sampled sites, 45 m is an instrument depth only where specified, and 500–1,000 m are explicitly seabed contours. Local phases remain separate from a seasonal range, whole-eddy maximum, simultaneous depth profile or shear. No horizontal clipping observed. All 138 captures executed; only these five retained PNGs were manually reviewed in the corrected review.

coverage_interpretation: 401 numeric references across 136 source identities, including 162 size references owned by 87 identities; 49 size-reference gaps remain. Own numeric coverage remains 121 identities, with 15 lacking it. Five phase-specific local Nelson current diagnostics add measurement depth without closing its size gap. Source identities are not a global physical census.
scope_limits: Koch presentation at the November 1990 meeting, published October 1991 in MMS 91-0040; original PDF pages 332–333 verified.
Below 0.4 knots applies at 45 m to most sampled eastern Green Canyon drilling sites in an imprecisely dated two-week phase; not a whole-eddy speed limit.
September 25, 1989 maximum of 1.4 knots is at 45 m. August surface band is 2.2–2.7 knots; exact surface sample depth unspecified.

Early September 3.6-knot and final-phase 2.6-knot local maxima have unknown sample depths and do not inherit 45 m from another phase. Site movement and different support prevent pooling these values into one profile or seasonal range.
500–1,000 m contours are seabed location context, not sample depths. Bottom-topography influence is not eddy thickness.
Registry physical association and separation conventions remain unverified. The inaccessible OTC 6537-MS paper is only an access lead; no dimensions copied from it.
No size, lifespan, physical footprint, state containment, ranking, seasonal playback, runtime installation or release.
